meaning_by_symbol.DIM: all faces dim, faint hum, washed patterns
meaning_by_symbol.WOBB: wobbling edges, bulging faces, muffled hum
meaning_by_symbol.DRIFT: drifting light, blurred edges, wavering pitch
meaning_by_symbol.FLICK: chaotic face flicker, broken irregular hum
meaning_by_symbol.OVER: too bright all over, layered hum, frozen faces
meaning_by_symbol.LEAK: corners and edges dim, center fine, thin hollow hum
meaning_by_symbol.BLAZE: all faces blazing white, loud buzz, surface heat
meaning_by_symbol.PULSE: opposite faces alternating bright and dark, 2-tone sync hum
meaning_by_symbol.DEAD: 1-2 corners bright and hot, clicking or ticking sound
meaning_by_symbol.STALL: frozen dim patterns, silence, cold surface
meaning_by_symbol.SPLIT: 2 clashing tones, 2 alternating patterns, shimmering edges
meaning_by_symbol.THERM: very hot and dim, low rumble, reddish tint, rough surface
meaning_by_symbol.VOID: normal outside, hollow tap sound, dark center

reply.rationale: No defensible paradigm network is supported by the codebook. The only suggested family, shared prefix STA in STALL and STABLE, fails the paradigm tests: there is no clear shared morphotactic frame with contrasting fillers making corresponding meaning contrasts, and the meanings are not compositionally predictable from a common STA contribution plus residues. More broadly, the symbols behave like opaque condition labels rather than products of a productive construction. Therefore the safest analysis is a flat lexicon with no segmented entries.
